components.name: InfiniteMasonry
components.doc: Masonry feed: cards of different heights fill the shortest column, and the next page loads when the end scrolls into view.

members.name: id
members.doc: Unique id. Cards with an id already in the feed are skipped.

members.name: title
members.doc: Name of the shot, shown under the image.

members.name: author
members.doc: Who made it, shown under the title.

members.name: ratio
members.doc: Image height divided by its width. The grid reserves this space before the image loads.

members.name: likes
members.doc: Like count before the visitor's own like.

members.name: initialItems
members.doc: Cards shown before any loading. Defaults to the first sample page.

members.name: loadPage
members.doc: Loads the next page. Receives the page number (1 for the first load after the initial cards). Resolve with an empty list to end the feed. Defaults to a simulated loader.

members.name: minColumnWidth
members.doc: Narrowest a column may get, in px. The grid fits as many columns as its width allows.

members.name: maxColumns
members.doc: Most columns the grid uses, however wide it gets.

members.name: onLikeChange
members.doc: Called when a card's like button is toggled.
